sample_label: Backend archive contract and migration observation
independence: Non-independent verification in the implementation context; focused tests and runtime Flyway provide heterogeneous sensors.

measurements.raw_evidence: Unread archive returns explicit conflict, read archive is idempotent, and recipient-scoped predicates are asserted.
ARCHIVED queries and restore behavior are covered; restore changes archived_at only.
Bulk update requires is_read = 1 and archived_at IS NULL and returns the actual changed count.

measurements.sensor: Query predicate and module summary tests
measurements.raw_evidence: ALL and UNREAD exclude archives while ARCHIVED and its module summary include only archives.

measurements.sensor: Controller/service contract review and Flyway runtime
measurements.raw_evidence: No archive API accepts client tenant/user identity; V79 applied without deleting or rewriting notification data.
limitation: A separate authenticated second-user browser session was unavailable; isolation is covered at the service SQL boundary.
